title: 上海高考翻译背诵-61-26一模青浦

items.zh: 初学做饭经常会出现这种问题，再试一次就好。
items.en: When you first learn to cook, such a problem often arises, but it will be fine after another try.

items.zh: 这款衬衫的价格比上周降了100元，现在买性价比特别高。
items.en: The price of the shirt has dropped by 100 yuan since last week, so it is now well worth the money/cost effective.

items.zh: 参与古籍修复工作坊后，我明白了看似简单的工序，需要耐心与技巧的双重打磨。
items.en: After engaging in the ancient book restoration workshop, I realized that seemingly simple procedures require a dural refinement patience of craftsmanship.

items.zh: 我们必须始终铭记那些对当下社会仍产生强大影响力的历史事件，以史为鉴，才能为下一代创造更美好的未来。
items.en: We must consistently keep in mind those historical events that still exert a strong influence on today’s society, learning from history to create a better future for the next generation.
